release_commit.description: commit of the installed framework release, recorded only when verification establishes it: bound by signed release metadata (evidence.provenance.release_commit), or the constant of the running gov binary when the payload is byte-identical to its embedded payload; otherwise 'unverified'. Never an unsigned manifest.json value and never the consumer repository's HEAD (BC-P2-37)

source.description: logical, machine-independent source kind decided from content, never from a path: release:<fw>@<v> (a release this machine verified) | embedded:<fw>@<v> (byte-identical to the running binary's embedded payload) | source:<fw>@<v> (an unauthenticated source)

installed_at_commit.description: consumer repository HEAD when the kernel was installed or updated

authenticity.description: what the single Signed Release Root verifier decided for these exact digests on the machine that installed them (AUTHENTIC | PREVIOUSLY_VERIFIED_BY_THIS_MACHINE | UNKNOWN). A record, never an input: trust is decided from protected machine state, not from this file (BC-P2-37)

sequence.description: signed release sequence, when the release was verified; null otherwise

channel.description: signed release channel, when the release was verified; null otherwise

release_metadata_sha256.description: sha256 of the verified release.json, when the release was verified against signed metadata; null otherwise

admission.description: what admitted the installed bytes on the installing machine (SIGNED_RELEASE_METADATA | PROTECTED_RECORD_OF_AN_EARLIER_VERIFICATION | BOOTSTRAP_EMBEDDED_PAYLOAD | NOT_ESTABLISHED). BOOTSTRAP_EMBEDDED_PAYLOAD marks the bootstrap installation of a gov binary's embedded payload that OWNER-DECISION-P2-0002 permits on a machine with no trust anchor; it is never presented as current, verified or certified. A record, never an input

identity_basis.description: the basis on which each identity field was recorded (BC-P2-37: the lock records identity and its basis; it never establishes trust)
